intro.title: Yellow Citrine Bracelet
intro.descriptionHtml: Lustrous Yellow Citrine Bracelets made from 100% natural Citrine stone in different Bead shapes, in various styles. Our collection includes Citrine with Rudraksha beads with German Silver accessories, Red Sandalwood Beads with Citrine, double turn Bracelets, sets of trendy Citrine Bracelet and Earrings and more. With the power of the Sun, the Bracelets when worn regularly brings clarity, positivity, joy, enhances confidence and self-esteem, attracts good fortune, success, prosperity and abundance.
